completion_promises.criterion_text: With a fixture feature yaml (3 tasks, parallel_groups [[a,b],[c]]), the planning_waves snapshot carries the correct totals in the existing schema fields (hermetic test, tmp repo dir)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _node_planning_waves to read .guardkit/features/<feature_id>.yaml, parse tasks[] count and orchestration.parallel_groups length. Test test_planning_waves_reads_task_graph creates a tmp repo with 3 tasks and [[TASK-A,TASK-B],[TASK-C]] parallel_groups, verifies wave_total=2 and task_total=3 in the snapshot. Also fixed _build_snapshot to correctly handle wave_total=0 and task_total=0 (was using 'or 1' which treated 0 as falsy).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Missing yaml / malformed yaml / feature id absent from the file each produce the current placeholder snapshot + a WARNING naming the resolved path — never an exception (three hermetic tests)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented error handling with try/except for yaml.YAMLError and OSError. Missing file triggers a WARNING log with the resolved path. Malformed yaml triggers a WARNING with the path and error. Feature id absent from the file (file exists but no matching feature yaml) triggers a WARNING. Three dedicated tests verify each case: test_planning_waves_missing_yaml, test_planning_waves_malformed_yaml, test_planning_waves_feature_id_absent. Three additional caplog tests verify WARNING messages are emitted.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The repo path is resolved via the same helper running_wave uses (asserted by test — no duplicated resolution logic); AutobuildState schema and graph shape byte-unchanged; existing runner tests pass unmodified
completion_promises.evidence: _node_planning_waves calls _resolve_repo_path(payload) directly — same helper used by _node_running_wave. Test test_planning_waves_uses_resolve_repo_path patches and asserts _resolve_repo_path was called once with the payload. Test test_planning_waves_schema_unchanged validates the snapshot against AutobuildState model and checks all 20 expected keys match. All 39 existing runner tests pass unmodified (verified with pytest).
